meta.lab_coverage_note: v1.0.0 + bnn-lab 1.0.0 on PyPI (2026-08-14). Wave 1 lanes A–I merged (PRs #16–#24, #26). WASM / .bnnpack v2 / distill / layer search / bitnet pin / RAPL-proxy closed. Intentional OpenGaps: gap_litespark_local, gap_venue_submit, gap_reactnet_in_repo (open); gap_fbi_llm_repro (accepted_non_goal). 2026 literature overlay: ScaleQ-1.58, BitEmbed, VibeASR-BitNet, Litespark — no invented local numbers. Thesis lock unchanged.

gap_fbi_llm_repro.summary: Fully binary LLM path (FBI-LLM, arXiv:2407.07093) is literature / accepted non-goal — cite only; this lab does not reproduce it as a gate.

paper_litespark.summary: Dade et al. arXiv:2605.06485 — SIMD ternary CPU kernels (Litespark-Inference). Paper claims large speedups vs naive PyTorch on Apple Silicon / x86. Not reproduced in this lab; local numbers stay OpenGap (gap_litespark_local). Do not copy paper × as goldens.

nodes.label: ScaleQ-1.58 / AYOT (Wang et al. 2026)
nodes.summary: Wang et al. arXiv:2608.01078 — ternary PTQ for reasoning LLMs: Attend to Your Own Thoughts (AYOT) calibration + CAT-Q. Paper reports Qwen3-1.7B ternary >90.52% of BitNet b1.58 2B4T on 4 math/coding tasks with 4M calib tokens, and a Qwen3-4B absolute +8.97% vs that baseline; claims scaling to 235B. Literature only — this lab does not reproduce ScaleQ or treat those figures as goldens. Distinct from naive absmean PTQ wipe.

nodes.label: BitEmbed / BITEMBED (Li et al. 2026)
nodes.summary: Li et al. arXiv:2606.25674 — convert pretrained LLM backbones into BitNet-style text embedders (ternary weights, quantized activations) via contrastive CPT + teacher distillation; MMTEB (eng, v2) experiments on Qwen3-0.6B / Gemma3-270M. Literature only. docs/15 names BitEmbed as an embeddings routing hint — not a lab golden.

nodes.label: VibeVoice-ASR-BitNet (Xu et al. 2026)
nodes.summary: Xu et al. arXiv:2607.21075 — VibeVoice-ASR-BitNet: INT8 VAE acoustic tokenizer + BitNet-style ternary AR LM; paper claims 1.6–2.3× vs Whisper.cpp at ~1.6 GB and RTF < 1 on low-thread CPUs. Their stack, not this lab. Audio lane remains synthetic pedagogy (decision_nongoal_asr_whisper).
